verdict.rationale: Datadog documents an llms.txt index at docs.datadoghq.com/llms.txt, and a probe confirms it returns HTTP 200 as the 'canonical entry point to the documentation'. Docs pages also link markdown versions (e.g. llm_observability.md, api/latest.md, mcp_server.md), and the docs include a paste-in prompt for coding agents. The probe 404 hit a different URL pattern (/llm_observability/.md) from the documented one, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: no hands-on verification that the documented .md page URLs resolve, and no independent community corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
